nodes.label: Feedback 10/1

metadata.implementation: All 14 items are implemented in stacked PRs #98 to #102 (merge in order).

nodes.label: Rows drawer needs an expanded (current) and small view

metadata.implementation: PR #101: the Rows drawer has a narrow size beside its expanded one; narrow keeps the charts visible and in use.

nodes.context: I think all inspectors need to have a big and narrow size.
nodes.rawContext: I think all inspectors need to have a big and narrow size.

nodes.label: tooltip for scatter is too large and "in the way"

metadata.implementation: PR #102: hovered scatter values read in one line in the chart header instead of a box over the plot.

nodes.context: Need to find a way for it to live outside the chart or to be less aggressive.
nodes.rawContext: Need to find a way for it to live outside the chart or to be less aggressive.

nodes.label: Chart focus should increase header size

metadata.implementation: PR #102: the chart details view shows the title at 20 px in a taller header.

nodes.context: It seems quite small compared to the enlarged chart.
nodes.rawContext: It seems quite small compared to the enlarged chart.

nodes.label: Improve the row view with small distribution in col header

metadata.implementation: PR #98: the Rows view draws each field's distribution under its column name (click or drag to filter). Data table charts can turn it on with Distributions in headers.

nodes.context: We have similar display available in the summary table.  It would be good to include it the various data table displays.  STart with the large row view.
nodes.rawContext: We have similar display available in the summary table.  It would be good to include it the various data table displays.  STart with the large row view.

nodes.label: row display

metadata.implementation: PRs #98, #99, #100 cover all nine row display items.

nodes.label: Would be nice to show data type clearly

metadata.implementation: PR #98: every table header shows the field's type icon before its name, with type, range, nulls, and distinct count on hover.

nodes.label: missing a robust right click menu on header and cells

metadata.implementation: PR #100: right-click menus on headers (filter, sort, move, reset width, hide, show hidden, copy name) and cells (copy value/row, filter to value, at or above/below, sort, hide).

nodes.context: Go ahead and get something implemented.  Should probably do some research to see what is common on other tools for right click in table.
nodes.rawContext: Go ahead and get something implemented.  Should probably do some research to see what is common on other tools for right click in table.

nodes.label: column picker looks goofy

metadata.implementation: PR #100: the column picker reuses the field list's rows (type, name, distinct, missing, distribution) through a shared FieldPicker, also used in data table chart settings.

nodes.context:
needs a refinement pass

this thing could really just be the summary table/field list again.  Not sure we need to reinvent this.  Use the same comp everywhere for picking fields (if we have the space)
nodes.rawContext: needs a refinement pass

nodes.label: search should highlight what matched

metadata.implementation: PR #98: table search marks the matched text in every cell; a match hidden by formatting marks the whole cell.

nodes.context: this is critical for a good experience
nodes.rawContext: this is critical for a good experience

nodes.label: Adding slider or distribution view to filter in popover

metadata.implementation: PR #99: number and date column filters show the field's distribution (click or drag to set the range); number fields add a two-thumb range slider.

nodes.label: Filter popover behaves oddly

metadata.implementation: PR #99: one filter popover now moves between columns instead of two overlapping for ~80 ms, and popovers close without an exit animation.

nodes.context: feels like flicker when opening one as another closes.
nodes.rawContext: feels like flicker when opening one as another closes.

nodes.label: Would be nice to drag columns left and right

metadata.implementation: PR #100: drag a column by its name to reorder it; a line marks the drop position. Move left/right is also in the column menu.

nodes.label: Would be nice to drag columns to gutter to remove variable

metadata.implementation: PR #100: drag a column's name away from the header and release to hide it; Escape cancels.

nodes.context: I think Excel pivot tables have this
nodes.rawContext: I think Excel pivot tables have this

nodes.label: Column header should match cell alignment

metadata.implementation: PR #98: number columns right-align their header with their cells; hover actions move to the left of number headers.

nodes.context: Things feel misaligned when header is left and cell is right.
nodes.rawContext: Things feel misaligned when header is left and cell is right.

nodes.label: chart settings should allow control of all filters on chart

metadata.implementation: PR #102: chart settings have a Filters tab with a manual control for every filter the chart sets, replacing the range-only Select tab.

nodes.context: Right now there is no manual input to change filters.
nodes.rawContext: Right now there is no manual input to change filters.

nodes.rawContext: These should be context dependent and include things like years, months, etc.

nodes.context: May need to just get rid of them.  Ideally the tooltip has a way to render in a spot that does not block the chart (maybe below it or something?)

Remove "inspect records" on metric tiles

metadata.implementation: All 10-04 issues implemented in one PR.

nodes.label: do side by side for order book example

metadata.implementation: Order book heatmap and Sankey now sit side by side (6x6 each). Reviewed other examples; the 10,000-order regional facet chart was shortened from 7 to 5 rows.

nodes.context: Review other examples and ensure we have good aspect ratio and proportions on charts
nodes.rawContext: Review other examples and ensure we have good aspect ratio and proportions on charts

nodes.label: do not have persistent text explaining how things work

metadata.implementation: Usage hints are split from status text and show only while the chart has hover or focus, in a smaller, lighter style.

nodes.context: We really need to disclosure only when needed and make these things subtler

nodes.label: box plot should support multiple selection

metadata.implementation: Each click on a box group now adds or removes it, like bar charts, so several groups can be selected.

nodes.context: do not limit to single selection
nodes.rawContext: do not limit to single selection

nodes.label: Remove inspect button

metadata.implementation: Removed standing Inspect buttons (distribution, bar, period, bin); Alt-click a mark inspects. Inspect records, Fit view, and Other categories buttons appear only on hover or focus.

nodes.context: Main chart surface should be chart only - no extra buttons always present
nodes.rawContext: Main chart surface should be chart only - no extra buttons always present

nodes.label: Field list is not left aligned on all bars

metadata.implementation: Field value rows now share one grid via subgrid, so bars start at the same x regardless of count width.

nodes.context: Related to the different count digit length?
nodes.rawContext: Related to the different count digit length?

nodes.label: Resizing a chart caused it to "jump" to end of all charts

metadata.implementation: Vertical compaction keeps a resized chart in place among neighbors; verified shrink and grow from every edge in the browser with no reordering.

nodes.context: I tried to resize down and the chart jumped to the end after all other charts.  It was jarring and not expected.  Always the least movement possible
nodes.rawContext: I tried to resize down and the chart jumped to the end after all other charts.  It was jarring and not expected.  Always the least movement possible

nodes.label: "add new chart" placement scrolls down

metadata.implementation: A new chart now starts in the visible rows: free space in view first, else the first chart edge in view. Placement and focus no longer scroll the page.

nodes.context: We want to start in the current view, do not move anywhere by default
nodes.rawContext: We want to start in the current view, do not move anywhere by default

nodes.label: Compact vertical space

metadata.implementation: The grid now always compacts vertically, so charts rise to fill empty rows above them.

nodes.context: We do not want to leave gaps at top, gravity goes up
nodes.rawContext: We do not want to leave gaps at top, gravity goes up

nodes.label: Group buttons in top nav better

metadata.implementation: Toolbar now leads with filter scope on the left; Add chart, Fields, Rows, and configuration sit on the right. Add chart is icon-only beside an open panel.

nodes.label: New chart icons do not match all real ones

metadata.implementation: Bar chart uses vertical column icon, Row chart horizontal bars, Histogram adjacent bins, Parallel coordinates axes with a line, Metric card a hash.

nodes.context: Bar chart icon shows horizontal bars but it has vertical bars
nodes.rawContext: Bar chart icon shows horizontal bars but it has vertical bars

nodes.label: 3D scatter needs some axis logic as main scatter

metadata.implementation: 3D scatter axes now plan like the main scatter: numeric fields span their range; text, category, boolean, and missing values get evenly spaced slots with jitter and category tick labels.

nodes.context: We should support all categorical and other non-numeric types
nodes.rawContext: We should support all categorical and other non-numeric types

nodes.label: Click should always filter

metadata.implementation: A plain click on a histogram bin sets the range filter to that bin's bounds; clicking the only selected bin clears it. Drag still selects a range.

nodes.context: Bar chart currently does not
nodes.rawContext: Bar chart currently does not
